The cross-card telemetry signature of a multi-day sub-$6 online ProductCD='C' micro-charge skimming wave links transactions on C12975-K2 to 16 peer cards.
The amount of the flagged transaction, $2.90, is below the card's prior median amount of $57.99 and maximum amount of $822.54 over 198 prior transactions.
The billing region 337.0 for transaction 3660260 is a known region for card C12975-K2, with 28 prior purchases over 25 days.
The purchaser email domain 'yahoo.com' associated with transaction 3660260 was used 34 times previously on this card.
The card's calibrated `cms_p` for transaction 3660260 was 0.000893, and the real-time risk score was 0.04.

case.summary: The verdict is fraud with 0.92 probability for an undocumented coordinated low-and-slow micro-charge skimming ring across 17 cards, including card C12975-K2. The episode involves six online transactions totaling $23.99 (3660255-3660260), starting 2017-01-05. This was driven by the customer's denial, a prior fraud case, and the detection of the coordinated pattern. A block of C12975-K2 (L1) and filing of a SAR (L2) are recommended, awaiting approval.

sar.narrative: This report details an undocumented coordinated fraud pattern, internal case ID AC-HHF-004. The case involves customer C12975 and their Visa debit card C12975-K2, along with 16 other connected cards, including C00129-K1, C00348-K1, C01326-K2, C03427-K2, C03488-K1, C03611-K2, C04274-K1, C04528-K1, C05083-K1, C05263-K2, C06198-K1, C09471-K2, C10035-K2, C10654-K1, C11332-K1, and C13290-K1. The suspicious activity on card C12975-K2 began on 2017-01-05 with an online transaction for $3.51 in region 191.0 (transaction 3660255). This was followed by five other online micro-charges (Product Code 'C'): $5.18 on 2017-01-07 (transaction 3660256), $2.66 on 2017-01-14 (transaction 3660257), $4.75 on 2017-01-18 (transaction 3660258), $4.99 on 2017-01-22 using device rv:11.0 | NULL | ie 11.0 for desktop | NULL (transaction 3660259), and the flagged transaction of $2.90 on 2017-01-26 (transaction 3660260). This series of transactions, occurring in regions 191.0 and 337.0, is part of a coordinated low-and-slow micro-charge skimming ring across 17 cards, identified through a shared multi-day sub-$6 online Product Code 'C' micro-charge skimming wave. The individual transaction amounts, while small, are significantly below the card's prior median transaction amount of $57.99 over 198 prior transactions. The customer reported transaction 3660260 as unauthorized. No prior suspicious activity report has been filed on card C12975-K2 (1 earlier closed case, none reported). OFAC screening of the customer and card identifiers against the SDN list returned no match. An internal case was opened, monitoring of connected cards was initiated, and an escalation to an analyst was done. A block of card C12975-K2 is recommended and awaits team-lead approval, and this report is recommended for filing, awaiting fraud-manager approval. The total suspicious amount involved is $23.99.
